worldcombat.skill.incinerate.summary: Sweep a fan of fire in front: every enemy inside takes a Fire special hit, and any Berry or Gem it carries is burned away for good, flaring the flame higher for extra damage.
worldcombat.skill.incinerate.use.0: Catch several opponents in front at once
worldcombat.skill.incinerate.use.1: Burn the target's Berry or Gem so it can never be used
worldcombat.skill.incinerate.use.2: A heavier flame against a holder of something flammable
worldcombat.skill.incinerate.description: The fan deals about %1$s Fire special damage with a %2$s degree half-angle; every non-friendly inside settles once, and the target's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.
The fan reaches %1$s blocks along your aim; a target burned of a Berry or Gem takes about %2$s extra power and loses the item for good.
worldcombat.skill.incinerate.wide.on: Wide on: the half-angle is x1.5, the hit x0.9, the reach x0.85 and the cooldown +4 ticks, trading damage for a broader sweep.
worldcombat.skill.incinerate.wide.off: Wide off: a narrower fan with longer reach, a heavier hit and a shorter cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.incinerate.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.incinerate.growth.0: At level %1$s, the flame power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.incinerate.growth.1: At level %1$s, the flame power rises to %2$s and the flare bonus to %3$s.
On: half-angle x1.5, reach x0.85, hit x0.9, cooldown +4, broader but shallower and shorter. Off: narrower, longer, heavier and a shorter cooldown.
Only sweep within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
On: it will leave its station under a hold order to sweep. Off: it only does so when the target is already in reach.
On: only used when the target carries a Berry or Gem, as a dedicated item-denial sweep. Off: bare-handed targets are swept as ordinary fan damage.
